tagline: Emping jagung crispy and traditional snack products from Poniyem in Pamulang.

story.title: Emping jagung crispy and traditional snack products from Poniyem in Pamulang.
story.body: Government records identify Poniyem in Bambu Apus, Pamulang, with the brand Lika Snack. A 2025 halal-assistance study in Pamulang specifically lists Lika Snack as an emping-jagung-crispy business, while another study records Lika Snack as a long-running snack UMKM.

stats.label: public records place the business in Bambu Apus
identity corroborated by government and academic sources
